name: AISurfaceTheme
description: CSS-scoped AI_RAMP surface themes via data-theme. Redefines --ai-* variables per variant; includes DS and shadcn bridge layers.
intent: Wrap any container in data-theme to theme AI, DS, and shadcn components without code changes. Theme files override Tier 1 palette only.

authority.note: Runtime CSS in components/ai/tokens/css/ — load ai-surface.css first

notes: Set data-theme on container or use SurfaceThemeProvider
Load css/ai-surface.css then css/ai-component-tokens.css then bridge CSS
DS: also require zs-master-style on ancestor + ds-bridge.css
Verify text contrast when switching to ai-bold or ai-companion

forbiddenUsage: Do not hardcode hex in components inside a themed surface
Do not load bridge CSS before ai-surface.css
Do not use data-theme without importing the CSS files
Do not replace zs-master-style with data-theme for DS hosts
agentRules: Read surface-theme.json for theme IDs and CSS load order
Use maps/ds-bridge.json when theming standard DS components
Use maps/shadcn-bridge.json when theming shadcn/ui components
Use maps/component-tokens.json for Tier 3 component slot resolution
